proposals.title: Proposed Procurement Allocations & Supplier Consent
proposals.subtitle: Unlike speculative platforms that assume unconfirmed stock, SasyaVahini mandates explicit supplier consent. Once you accept, the backend validates available inventory and locks it in the RESERVED state.
proposals.noPendingDesc: When institutional buyers post procurement requirements matching your produce listings, proposed allocations will appear here for your explicit consent.
proposals.consentModalBody: By accepting, {{qty}} kg of {{crop}} will be authoritatively locked in escrow for this buyer. Do you explicitly consent?

proposals.auditedEscrowBadge: Transparent Unit Accounting & Bank UTR Proof
proposals.bulkOrderSettlementsDesc: Direct financial accounting for your contributed produce in FPO bulk contracts. Review individual lot quantities, agreed purchase rates, authorized cooperative service fees, and bank disbursement transaction references.
proposals.fairTradeSettlementDesc: Every rupee is accounted for directly from the institutional buyer contract. Your payouts are computed from your verified produce contributions, unit rates agreed at aggregation, and bank transfer UTR proofs recorded by your cooperative management.

voice.smartAssistantIntro: Speak a complete sentence describing what you want to sell. For example:
voice.smartAssistantExample: "I want to sell 500 kg of Grade A tomatoes at 25 rupees per kg from Manchar."
voice.guideListingPrompt: This screen allows you to list your produce directly for institutional buyers. You need to enter your crop name, harvest quantity in kilograms, and your asking price per kilogram. If you prefer speaking, click the microphone button beside any box.
voice.guideConsentPrompt: SasyaVahini guarantees your rights through explicit supplier consent. No buyer can automatically lock your harvest without your approval. Review the offered rate and delivery date before clicking accept.
voice.guideFpoPrompt: FPO Aggregation enables smallholder farmers to pool their produce to meet large supermarket orders. The system automatically computes fair weighted prices so every farmer receives their rightful share.
voice.guideFarmerDashboard: Welcome to your Farmer Dashboard. Here you can monitor available stock, review buyer allocation requests, and use Smart Voice Listing to sell produce with fair pricing guidance.
voice.guideFpoMembersPrompt: Welcome to the FPO Cooperative Hub. Manage registered smallholder farmers, audit individual provenance, and consolidate supply for institutional purchase orders.
voice.guideFpoAggregationPrompt: FPO Produce Aggregation Engine. Combine lots from multiple smallholders. The system calculates the mathematically fair volume-weighted asking rate to protect member earnings.
voice.guideMarketIntelligencePrompt: SasyaVahini AI Market Intelligence. Explore 7-day price trajectories, probabilistic P10 to P90 demand quantiles, and APMC road arbitrage to maximize harvest profit.
voice.browserTeluguVoiceNote: Note: If your browser does not have a native Indian voice installed, audio synthesizes using default system voice with the full transcript displayed above.
voice.guideRegisterPrompt: Welcome to SasyaVahini registration. Please enter your name, contact, and profile details to join.
